                                        ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BT THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. That Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
be amended by changing all of the M3-3 Heavy Industry District symbols and indications as
shown on Map 5-H in the area bounded by

       West Fullerton Avenue; a line 247.92 feet east of North Elston Court as measured along
       the southern right-of-way line of West Fullerton Avenue and perpendicular thereto;
       the alley next south of West Fullerton Aveue; and a line 297.92 feet east of North Elston
       Court as measued along the southern righ-of-way line of West Fullerton Avenue and
       perpendicular thereto

to those of an Ml-2 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
publication.
